description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
When Tarpan enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
